title: Theo the Little Mountain Train and the Sleepy Snowfall
description: A little teal mountain train and his mountain-goat friend carry a tiny music box up to a snowy hilltop chalet, then settle into a quiet valley sleep beneath soft snowfall.

Theo.role: Main character; a toy-like mountain steam locomotive
Theo.color: Deep teal-blue boiler and cab with a warm cream cab roof, dark charcoal smokestack and undercarriage, brass-gold headlamp surround, and a cream front face plate
Theo.bodyShape: Compact short rounded engine with four small dark steel wheels, a tiny brass bell behind the smokestack, and one permanently coupled low honey-brown open wagon; no arms, hands, legs, numbers, or lettering
Theo.face: Only on the flat circular cream smokebox plate: two large dark-brown oval eyes, small curved eyebrows, rosy cheek dots, and a gentle curved smile; the headlamp is equipment, never an eye
Theo.accessories: Single round warm-white front headlamp and a tiny brass bell

Maren.role: Supporting character; a small mountain goat who first appears on page 3
Maren.color: Pale oatmeal fur with a creamy muzzle and belly, tiny curved cocoa-brown horns, dusty-rose inner ears, and cocoa-colored hooves
Maren.bodyShape: Small young mountain goat shorter than Theo's cab doorway, with short rounded ears, a short tail, and four small hooves; no hands or upright human posture
Maren.face: Dark-brown oval eyes, little charcoal-brown nose, and a gentle smile when awake
Maren.accessories: Single muted cranberry-red knitted scarf wrapped once around her neck with two short ends

settingBible.Alpine Mountain Railway: A miniature alpine railway from a sheltered pine valley to one hilltop chalet, with narrow-gauge rails, snow-laden fir trees, warm cabin windows, and soft nonthreatening snowfall
settingBible.Hilltop Chalet and Valley Shed: A red-brown timber chalet with three hanging golden lanterns and a sheltered porch, plus a sage-green valley station with a wooden shed, dry shelf, and adjacent siding
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded train and goat, golden afternoon fading to moonlit blue snow, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Theo keeps his teal-blue body, cream face plate, brass headlamp, tiny bell, and exactly one honey-brown open wagon.
Maren stays smaller than Theo with oatmeal fur, tiny horns, and a cranberry-red scarf, and first appears on page 3.
The music box travels wrapped in blue cloth, plays open on the chalet porch on page 9, and rests on the shed shelf from page 12 onward.
Pages 13–15 keep Maren in the right shed nook and Theo on the left siding in the same geography.
No rescue, danger, storm peril, music notes, lettering, or extra named characters.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: Theo the little mountain train puffed happily through the pine-covered valley as the afternoon sun gilded the tracks.
pages.illustrationScene: Teal mountain train Theo puffs alone through a pine-covered valley as afternoon sun gilds the tracks.

pages.text: Tonight, Theo would carry a tiny music box to the hilltop chalet for its cozy evening gathering.
pages.illustrationScene: Theo rolls alone on a valley curve with the distant hilltop chalet visible uphill in late afternoon light.

pages.text: His friend Maren, a small mountain goat, waited by the station with the music box tucked in a soft blue cloth.
pages.illustrationScene: Mountain goat Maren waits at the valley station with a music box wrapped in soft blue cloth as Theo arrives.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: Theo stopped beside Maren, and together they settled the little music box safely into his open wagon.
pages.illustrationScene: Theo and Maren settle the wrapped music box safely into Theo's open honey-brown wagon at the station.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: With a cheerful toot, Theo rolled past snowy fir trees while Maren rode snugly in the wagon beside the box.
pages.illustrationScene: Theo climbs past snowy fir trees while Maren rides snugly in the wagon beside the wrapped music box.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: Little flakes drifted down as the mountain path curved gently between glowing cabin windows.
pages.illustrationScene: Sparse snowflakes drift as Theo and Maren pass glowing cabin windows on the mountain path at early dusk.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: Maren listened to the hush of the snow, and Theo slowed his wheels to enjoy the peaceful evening.
pages.illustrationScene: Theo and Maren enjoy a quiet curved mountain track in lilac dusk with delicate snowfall.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: At the hilltop chalet, warm golden lanterns shone, but Maren still carried the music box onto the sheltered porch.
pages.illustrationScene: At the hilltop chalet, Maren carries the wrapped music box onto the sheltered porch while Theo waits on the track.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: The music box played a soft tinkling tune, and Theo listened from the track while the first stars appeared.
pages.illustrationScene: On the chalet porch the open music box plays as Maren listens and Theo waits on the nearby track under first stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: When the tune ended, Maren wrapped the music box again, and together the friends watched the snow settle over the rooftops.
pages.illustrationScene: Maren rewraps the closed music box while Theo and Maren watch gentle snow settle over the chalet rooftops.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: Theo and Maren traveled slowly home beneath the lavender sky, with the music box snug in the wagon.
pages.illustrationScene: Theo rolls slowly home on the descending track with Maren and the wrapped music box snug in the wagon.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity.

pages.text: At the little valley station, Theo parked beside the wooden shed while Maren lifted the music box onto a dry shelf.
pages.illustrationScene: At the valley station Maren places the music box on a dry shed shelf while Theo parks on the adjacent siding.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity. Final geography: Maren RIGHT in shed nook, Theo LEFT on siding.

pages.text: Maren curled into her straw-lined nook inside the shed, and Theo rested on his familiar siding just outside.
pages.illustrationScene: Maren curls in her right straw-lined shed nook while Theo rests on the left siding just outside.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity. Final geography: Maren RIGHT in shed nook, Theo LEFT on siding.

pages.text: Moonlight silvered the snow as Maren closed her eyes and Theo's little headlamp dimmed to a gentle glow.
pages.illustrationScene: Same shed-and-siding view: Maren's eyes closed, Theo's headlamp dim, moonlight silvering the snow.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity. Final geography: Maren RIGHT in shed nook, Theo LEFT on siding. Eyes closed / asleep; no smoke.

pages.text: Beneath the quiet stars, Theo and Maren drifted peacefully to sleep while soft snow tucked their mountain home into silence.
pages.illustrationScene: Same sleeping positions under quiet stars: Theo and Maren fully asleep as soft snow hushes their mountain home.
pages.continuityNotes: Theo and Maren; one wagon; music-box continuity. Final geography: Maren RIGHT in shed nook, Theo LEFT on siding. Eyes closed / asleep; no smoke.
